def test_usd_payee_with_comma_is_quoted_and_matches_the_header():
    import csv
    import io

    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD")]
    )
    assert text.splitlines()[1] == 'chk-100,2024-06-02,"Smith, Jones LLP",12.50,retainer'
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))
    assert len(rows[1]) == len(rows[0])
    assert rows[1] == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]


def test_memo_with_quote_is_escaped():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Acme", 100, 'say "hi"', "USD")]
    )
    assert text.splitlines()[1] == 'chk-100,2024-06-02,Acme,1.00,"say ""hi"""'
EOF
